preconditions.description: The length of string s is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The lengths of strings s and t are equal.
String s is lexicographically less than string t.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in string s are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: All characters in string t are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: output == 'No such string' or (len(output) == len(s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in output) and s < output < t)
postconditions.description: The output is either 'No such string' or a string that is lexicographically larger than s and at the same time is lexicographically smaller than t.
